description: Somos Hidro Energy Solutions, un equipo multidisciplinario enfocado en la creación de tecnología sostenible para la agricultura ante al cambio climático, respaldado por una patente registrada y dos artículos científicos publicados. Nuestro proyecto es un dispositivo de monitoreo, control térmico y ventilación automatizada para mantener un ambiente controlado y monitoreado con toma de decisiones en tiempo real y IA.
summary: We adapted a patented environmental monitoring and automation system—originally designed to regulate ventilation—into an intelligent precision irrigation controller for crops. By integrating real-time field sensors with NASA Earth observation data (such as soil moisture, precipitation, and temperature datasets), our system dynamically activates and optimizes water delivery only when and where crops need it. This solution directly addresses agricultural water scarcity and climate variability, significantly reducing water waste while maximizing crop yield and sustainability for farmers.
details:
What does it do? Our project is a precision agricultural monitoring and automated irrigation control system. It adapts an existing patented control architecture—originally engineered to automate ventilation systems—to intelligently regulate water valves and irrigation pumps based on real-time crop needs and satellite environmental data.

How does it work? The system operates through a closed-loop control architecture combining local hardware with space-based intelligence:

  1. Field Sensing: On-site sensors continuously monitor microclimatic variables such as soil moisture, ambient temperature, and humidity.
  2. Satellite Data Integration: The control algorithm cross-references local readings with NASA Earth observation datasets (such as NASA POWER, SMAP soil moisture, and GPM precipitation forecasts) to anticipate rainfall and evapotranspiration rates.
  3. Automated Actuation: Replacing the original ventilation relays with hydraulic solenoid valves and pump controllers, the patented logic triggers irrigation exclusively when soil moisture drops below optimal thresholds and no immediate precipitation is forecasted.

What are the benefits?

  • Water Conservation: Eliminates over-irrigation and prevents watering right before rainfall, drastically reducing agricultural water waste.
  • Proven Reliability: Leverages a pre-validated, patented control framework, ensuring industrial-grade stability and rapid deployment.
  • Crop Health & Yield: Maintains consistent soil hydration levels, preventing plant stress and improving harvest quality.

What do we hope to achieve? We aim to provide farmers—especially in drought-prone and water-scarce regions—with an affordable, scalable, and automated irrigation solution that bridges the gap between orbital Earth science and ground-level agricultural hardware.

Tools, Hardware & Software Used:

  • Hardware: Patented environmental control unit, soil moisture/temperature sensors, microcontrollers [e.g., ESP32 / Arduino / PLC], relays, and solenoid irrigation valves.
  • Software & Languages: [e.g., Python, C++, IoT dashboard / cloud platform].
  • Data Sources: NASA Open Data APIs (NASA POWER / SMAP / GPM).
dataRefs: We utilized the NASA POWER (Prediction Of Worldwide Energy Resources) API and Agroclimatology datasets
